title: Visitor calls Strieber 'the luckiest of the lucky'

tellings.quote: one of the visitors when I was in the abduction experience said to me, "You're the luckiest of the lucky."

plain: Whitley Strieber, an author who has written about being taken by beings he calls the visitors, told Jesse Michels about something said to him during one of those experiences in the 1980s. He says one of the visitors told him, "You're the luckiest of the lucky." He tells it as a sign of how the visitors saw him.
